functional_binding.note: Core, layer and independent tail numerical receipts passed before physical execution. Physical signoff nevertheless fails.

runtime_chain_binding.basis: The six runtime-chain RTL sources, including postprocess, are byte-identical to A. Only B runner RTL differs, outside runtime_chain scope.

layer_shell.scope: actual B runner, storage, 24-MAC probe, fixed-TEST adapter, unchanged runtime pre/post, RNE and SiLU inside unchanged low-I/O shell
layer_shell.resource_conclusion: B saves 128 measured cycles but does not save Slice; it adds 181 Slice versus A.

functional_reset_distribution.classification: separate specialized report with the same four endpoint registers but a different launch; do not add these paths to the 77 coverage records or call them four new endpoint failures

critical_path_root_cause.four_pre_acc_paths: Data delay 10.270 ns = 1.513 ns cell plus 8.757 ns net; five LUT levels; max fanout 47. Dominant final mux79_syn_2[14] net has fanout 40 and 4.933 ns net delay.
critical_path_root_cause.A_pre_acc7_comparison: A is +1.954 ns with 7.873 ns data delay = 1.481 ns cell plus 6.392 ns net, five LUT levels and fanout 40. B adds 2.365 ns net delay while cell delay and logic depth remain close.
critical_path_root_cause.tail_logic_membership: The four failing paths remain entirely in the unchanged postprocess PRE tag/ready-enable cone. New flag_dw_tail/address selection logic is not directly on these paths.
critical_path_root_cause.fifth_internal_path: The -0.449 ns flag_fatal to DW-weight RAM write-enable path uses existing load/count/write-enable logic; no flag_dw_tail, cnt_mac_group or new tail-address signal is directly on the path.
critical_path_root_cause.inference: The B runner change increases placed resource and changes routing/congestion. This is the evidence-backed cause category; it is not proof of a single deterministic placer mechanism.

syn5025.disposition: The generic warning remains unlocalized and unwaived. No blanket benign assertion is made because the tool did not enumerate each zeroed object.

retirement_bank_driver_proof.result: The same three full-element RTL writes and byte-identical postprocess source bind A's per-bank structural proof. B's own synthesized layer netlist also retains separate alpha/beta/gamma RAM structures and no HDL-5314 warning.
retirement_bank_driver_proof.limitation: Static write-source evidence does not replace gate-level numerical equivalence.

verification_gap.reason: The existing numerical bench targets the RTL layer interface, not the serialized physical shell, and no already-qualified vendor-primitive gate bench/library flow exists here.
verification_gap.accepted_evidence: Bound passing RTL receipts plus own routed database and structural bank evidence only.
